content: I want to build a REST API for managing bookmarks with tags. Should use Node.js and PostgreSQL.

Great, I'll set up the project. We decided to use Express with TypeScript for the API layer and Knex.js for database migrations.

TODO: set up database schema
TODO: add authentication middleware
For auth, we must use JWT tokens. OAuth is not allowed by the team policy.

Understood. The constraint is that we must use JWT, not OAuth. I'll implement a JWT middleware.

Created these files:
- src/middleware/auth.ts
- src/routes/bookmarks.ts

```typescript
const token = jwt.sign({ userId }, SECRET);
```
Add the bookmark CRUD endpoints now.

I've implemented the CRUD endpoints:

POST /api/bookmarks - Create bookmark
GET /api/bookmarks - List bookmarks
GET /api/bookmarks/:id - Get single bookmark
PUT /api/bookmarks/:id - Update bookmark
DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id - Delete bookmark

We decided to use soft deletes for data safety.

Next step: add tag filtering and search.
